na mo/rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/chos kyi bka' bden pa

tei:div.tei:p: na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gzhan yang snying po phyag rgya gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bla ma'i sku dgra/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa gang na su mchis pa de dag gi rnam par shes pa tshogs tha ma 'di la khug cig /oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍe hoḥ
